name: ghpreview
description: Preview HTML files from explicitly allowlisted GitHub repositories.

background.comment: Fetches GitHub content because /raw/ redirects away from the page origin.

content_scripts.comment: Do not intercept GitHub traffic or inject code into the page's MAIN world.
content_scripts.comment2: Start early so the source is visible for less time while the preview is prepared.

sandbox.comment: The only place where repository JavaScript may run; never grant allow-same-origin.
